item.text: The no-file startup path also bypassed `config.Load`, which is why env overrides were ignored at runtime even if the loader supported them. I’ve updated both paths: empty config paths now use Viper defaults plus env bindings, and startup always loads through `config.Load`. Next I’m running the existing config and CLI package tests.
